name: Only rehash makes a new hash protocol effective

input.source_text: class Key { public property equal_id: Integer = 0 public property hash_code: Integer = 0 public fun ==(other: Object) -> Bool { @equal_id == other.equal_id() } public fun hash() -> Integer { @hash_code } public fun equal_id() -> Integer { @equal_id } } module M { public fun run() -> Array { mut k = Key.new(); k.equal_id = 1; k.hash_code = 1; mut h = %{}; h[k] = :ok; k.hash_code = 2; let before = h[k]; h.rehash(); [before, h.fetch(k)] } } M.run()
